articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Eurazeo Index Exit Puts Focus On Losses Liquidity And Growth Plans. Eurazeo (ENXTPA:RF) has been removed from the FTSE All-World Index. The change affects the company's inclusion in a widely tracked global equity benchmark. Eurazeo's exit from the FTSE All-World Index comes at a time when the share price is €41.76 and the stock has recorded a 6.4% gain over the past week.
